name: TapeMachine 2
purpose: Analog tape emulation adding saturation, head bump, gentle compression and optional wow and flutter; Swiss deck for tracking and mix colour, American deck for mastering.

latency.note: Fixed 2x oversampled core: 56 samples (1.2 ms) at 48 kHz, measured by plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp.

params.name: Tape Machine
params.ai_hint: Swiss for tracks and mix buses; American for mastering.

params.name: Tape Speed
params.ai_hint: 15 IPS is the all-round default. 7.5 IPS = more head bump and lo-fi; 30 IPS = cleaner, tighter low end.

params.name: Tape Type
params.ai_hint: 456 classic warm saturation; GP9 cleaner with more headroom.

params.name: Input Gain
params.ai_hint: The main saturation control. 0 to +3 dB subtle; +6 dB and above clearly driven.

params.name: Highpass Freq
params.ai_hint: Cleans up low rumble; leave at 20 Hz unless needed.

params.name: Lowpass Freq
params.ai_hint: Rolls off the top end for a darker, vintage sound.

params.name: Wow
params.ai_hint: Slow pitch drift. Keep low (under 10%) unless a lo-fi effect is wanted.

params.name: Flutter
params.ai_hint: Fast pitch wobble. Keep low unless a lo-fi effect is wanted.

params.name: Auto Compensation
params.ai_hint: Keep on so output level follows drive changes.

hidden_params.reason: Signal path, EQ standard, bias, calibration, noise, oversampling, American-only switches, advanced repro EQ and the hidden factory-preset calibration trims stay at defaults.

notes: 3.75 IPS is American-only, so it is excluded from the speed options.
TapeMachine 2 ships 20 calibrated factory presets (TapeMachinePresets.hpp); a preset extractor is a follow-up task.
CPU: 14.48% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
